segments.name: United States electrical construction and facilities services
products: Systems for electrical power transmission, distribution, and generation
Premises electrical and lighting systems
Low-voltage systems, such as fire alarm, security, and process control systems
Voice and data communications, including fiber optic and low voltage cabling
Sustainable energy solutions such as solar, photovoltaic, and wind
Roadway and transit lighting and signaling and fiber optic lines
Computerized traffic control systems
segments.description: Provides electrical construction and facilities services, including power, lighting, low-voltage, and communications systems, to commercial, industrial, healthcare, and institutional customers.
segments.evidence: Such operating subsidiaries are organized into the following reportable segments: • United States electrical construction and facilities services;

segments.name: United States mechanical construction and facilities services
products: Heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration
Clean-room process ventilation systems
Fire protection and suppression systems
Plumbing, process and high-purity piping systems
Water and wastewater treatment systems
Central plant heating and cooling systems
Millwright services
Steel fabrication, erection, and welding services
segments.description: Provides mechanical construction and facilities services, including HVAC, piping, fire protection, and water treatment systems, for a broad range of facility types.
segments.evidence: Such operating subsidiaries are organized into the following reportable segments: • United States electrical construction and facilities services; • United States mechanical construction and facilities services;

segments.name: United States building services
products: Maintenance and services for mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire safety, and
HVAC projects, including installation, modification and retrofits
Energy efficiency retrofit services
Technical consulting and diagnostic services
Facility management, maintenance, and services
Floor care and janitorial services
Landscaping, lot sweeping, and snow removal
Vendor management and call center services
segments.description: Provides facilities services, including maintenance, energy efficiency retrofits, and facility management, to owners, operators, tenants, and managers of facilities.
segments.evidence: Our building services operations, which generated approximately 21% of our 2025 total revenues, provide services to owners, operators, tenants, and managers of all types of facilities.

segments.name: United States industrial services
segments.description: Provides industrial services, generally directly to refineries and petrochemical plants.
segments.evidence: We generally provide industrial services directly to refineries and petrochemical plants.

segments.name: United Kingdom building services
segments.evidence: On December 1, 2025, we sold our United Kingdom operations, the results of which are reported within our United Kingdom building services segment through the date of sale.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including corporations, governments, owners, developers, tenants, and general contractors acting as subcontractors, pay EMCOR for electrical and mechanical construction, building, and industrial services.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide construction services and building services directly to corporations, municipalities and federal and state governmental entities, owners/developers, and tenants of buildings.

changes.text: In 2025, EMCOR sold its United Kingdom operations, which had comprised the United Kingdom building services segment.
changes.evidence: On December 1, 2025, we sold our United Kingdom operations, the results of which are reported within our United Kingdom building services segment through the date of sale.
